spans.s:
शिथिर शिथिर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्रथ्),
Ved. = शिथिल, relaxed, loose, &c.; outstretched,
extended, (Sāy. = दानार्थम् प्रसारित, Ṛg-veda

); (अम्), n. anything relaxed or undone
(as a bond, fetter, &c.).
शिथिल, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s.

.
fr. श्लथ् for rt. श्रथ्), loose, loosened, slackened,
relaxed, untied, unfastened, undone, lax, flaccid,
flabby, not rigid or compact; dishevelled (as hair);
dissolved; decayed; languid, inert, weak, unnerved,
feeble; ineffective, unenergetic; not strict, not carefully
or strictly observed, loosely performed; loosely retained
or possessed, abandoned, shaken off; (अम्), n. a
loose fastening; looseness, laxity, slowness; a parti-
cular kind of separation or combination of the terms
or members of a logical series.
—शिथिल-ता, f. or
शिथिल-त्व, अम्, n. looseness, laxity, relaxedness,
relaxation; the being unfastened, a state of disso-
lution, want of energy, languor.
—शिथिल-प्र-
यत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, (one) whose efforts are relaxed.
—शिथिल-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, relaxed in strength,
weakened, relaxed.
—शिथिल-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, hav-
ing impaired wealth; shining with diminished rays.
—शिथिल-शक्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, impaired in strength or
power.
—शिथिली-करण, अम्, n. the act of loosen-
ing, unfastening; impairing, weakening, reducing,
—शिथिली-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to make loose, loosen, unfasten; to relax,
slacken; to make languid, weaken, enfeeble, impair;
to remit, dismiss, give up, abandon.
—शिथिली-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, made loose, loosened, unfastened, un-
bound, slackened; let loose; impaired, weakened,
reduced.
—शिथिली-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवि-
तुम्, to become loosened or slackened, be relaxed,
to slacken.

शिथिलय, Nom. P. शिथिलयति, -यितुम्, to
loosen, make loose, relax.

शिथिलित, अस्, आ, अम्, loosed, let go; relaxed,
loosened; dissolved, made soft.
